displayName: Thorlabs PBS252 Polarizing Beamsplitter Cube (1 inch)

faces._role: INTERNAL Brewster plate at 45° diagonal (xz plane). Real surface normal (-0.7071, 0, 0.7071). Aperture = side·sqrt(2) ~ 17.96 mm. Used by pbs_reflect_s via mirror formula.

transitions._note: p-pol transmits straight through the Brewster plate (back -> front along +z).
s-pol mirror-reflects off B1 (normal (-0.7071,0,0.7071)). k=(0,0,1) -> k_out=(1,0,0) = right exit.
s-pol mirror-reflects off B1. k=(0,0,-1) -> k_out=(-1,0,0) = left exit.
s-pol mirror-reflects off B1. k=(-1,0,0) -> k_out=(0,0,-1) = back exit.
s-pol mirror-reflects off B1. k=(1,0,0) -> k_out=(0,0,1) = front exit.

notes.topology: Cube PBS with single internal Brewster plate B1 at 45 deg (xz diagonal, normal (-0.7071, 0, 0.7071)). 4 external faces + 1 internal face. 8 transitions (4 transmit pairs + 4 reflect pairs).
notes.reflectGeometry: B1 normal pairs reflections via mirror formula k_out = k_in - 2(k.n)n. Resulting pairs: back<->right, front<->left. (Previous catalog had a 4-cycle back->right->front->left->back which is physically inconsistent with a single plate -- fixed in this revision.)
notes.transmitPairs: Straight-through pairs: back<->front (along z), left<->right (along x). For these, k unchanged; only Jones projection + 5x5 slab applies.
